rows.label: Thor's Hammer Overpowered
rows.help: Loads the setting values to make weapons act like Thor's hammer for people playing in Crazy Extreme mode or for people who want test the mod without stamina cost. These settings will make you very Over Powered. It returns to you after you press the button again after throwing.

rows.label: Cangar's Selection
rows.help: Loads the setting values selected by Cangar. It has real gravity. Daggers and Two handed weapons are not set to auto return, others are auto returned. It has low Auto-Aim. Also Stamina cost is set to 40. Basically a modified medium preset to make it harder.

rows.label: Thor's Hammer Strong
rows.help: Loads the setting values to make weapons act like Thor's hammer for people playing in Hard mode. These settings will make you very strong. It returns to you after you press the button again after throwing.

rows.label: Arctal's Choices
rows.help: Loads the setting values selected by Arctal. Intended for using the throwing mechanic as a main weapon. It is therefore free of cost, has normal damage and high velocity so it can be thrown and recalled often. Specifically useful in combination with the Spellsiphon Imbue system. 2-handed weapons (like the Spellsiphon Bound Axe) do not return, have lower velocity and are set to have a knockdown force and a stamina cost. The intention with those are to provide an occasional extra control mechanic.

rows.label: Thor's Hammer Medium
rows.help: Loads the setting values to make weapons act like Thor's hammer for people playing in Normal mode. It returns to you after you press the button again after throwing.

rows.label: Thor's Hammer Weak
rows.help: Loads the setting values to make weapons act like Thor's hammer for people playing in Easy mode. It returns to you after you press the button again after throwing.

rows.label: Classic Strong
rows.help: Loads the Classic preset for people playing in Crazy Hard mode. These settings will make you very Over Powered. In this preset, Auto-Return mode is disabled and thrown weapons must be picked up from the ground/npc inventories like arrows.

rows.label: Classic Medium
rows.help: Loads the Classic preset for people playing in Normal mode. In this preset, Auto-Return mode is disabled and thrown weapons must be picked up from the ground/npc inventories like arrows.

rows.label: Classic Weak
rows.help: Loads the Classic preset for people playing in Easy mode. In this preset, Auto-Return mode is disabled and thrown weapons must be picked up from the ground/npc inventories like arrows.

rows.help: Prevents player favorited weapons from being thrown. Doesn't work in Auto Return mode.

rows.label: Stagger Magnitude
rows.help: Stagger magnitude applied when at least 0.5 impact force is set. Higher values make stagger longer.

rows.label: Reserve Last Weapon
rows.help: Only throws the weapon if you have at least 2 of them available in your inventory. This can be used to make sure unique weapons are never thrown. Note: Vanilla unique weapons are already not throwable. Doesn't work in Auto Return mode.

rows.label: Enable Torch Drop
rows.help: Enabling it enables dropping thrown torches in Classic Mode. Note that after it hits an object, a thrown torch will be dropped but it won't burn the area when this is enabled. Doesn't work in Auto Return mode.

rows.label: Button Release when Untouched
rows.help: Releasing the button requires you to untouch your finger from the button too.

rows.label: Enable Re-Equip
rows.help: Equips the thrown weapon again if you have one more in your inventory. Doesn't work in Auto Return mode.

rows.label: Enable Re-Equip Similar
rows.help: Equips the same type of weapon again if you have more in your inventory. Doesn't work in Auto Return mode.

rows.label: Equip Back Bound Spell
rows.help: Equip back the corresponding bound spell after throwing a bound weapon.

rows.label: Auto Re-Cast Bound Weapon
rows.help: Conjures a bound weapon again automatically after throwing it, if you have enough magicka.
